# Parked

> **Kind:** context · **Registry:** world · **Folder:** [`src/logic/systems/`](../folders/src-logic-systems.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/systems/system_set.h`](../../../src/logic/systems/system_set.h)

## Summary

World flag: the agent's episode ended mid-window and the world waits for the Observe phase.

## Description

World context variable emplaced by the World constructor (src/scene/world.cpp). While value is true, SystemSet::fixed_tick skips the Every and Act systems and runs only the Observe systems (simulation.md, parking). The sphere agent sets it in SphereTaskSys when the sphere leaves the bounds or falls, and clears it in SphereObserveSys at the end of the episode and in resetSphereEpisode. fixed_observe_only ignores it.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | `bool` | false | true: only Observe systems run |
